notes: Typed dependency edges distinguish runtime requirements from family relationships. Capability ownership is maintenance metadata only and never imported by runtime code.

dependency_edges.rationale: Provider reference parsing and player-option validation have one dependency-free owner.
Shared bounded collection parsing, selection metadata, and browser-control primitives.
Card/grid source formatting and presentation stay in the shared grid layer.
The gallery resolves the leaf player extension dynamically instead of importing it eagerly.
Relevant UI-family inventory without a gallery runtime dependency.

capability_ownership.description: Canonical YouTube video/channel/playlist reference parsing and validation.
Canonical validation and normalization for leaf YouTube player options.
YouTube catalog schema, query adaptation, explicit synchronization, and gallery orchestration.
Bounded collection loading, selection metadata, search/filter controls, and shared collection behavior.
Shared card/grid presentation and source-format delegation.
Leaf iframe/player rendering and player-local thumbnail fallback behavior.
PyData component inventory for the wider Sphinx UI-extension family.
